name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Revenue & CRM Operations Expert | CRM Ownership, Cross-Platform Workflows & Data Integrity
summary: Revenue and CRM operations professional with 15+ years owning CRM systems end to end, HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, and Accelo's own CRM/PSA platform, across SaaS and agency environments. Configures and maintains CRM and adjacent revenue tools spanning project tracking, billing, and workflow integrations, builds the documented processes that drive stakeholder adoption, and keeps data accurate across interconnected systems. Exercises independent operational judgment on policy and process conflicts and produces clear, actionable reporting for technical and non-technical audiences.

Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable across GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping project and process records auditable across concurrent engagements.
Design, implement, and optimize marketing automation and CRM systems for B2B service clients as a fractional success/implementation manager.
Lead end-to-end onboarding for new technology stacks, translating business requirements into technical configurations and providing hands-on training that drives adoption.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights to executive leadership.

bullets: Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.
